description: GAI-A is a React.js and Flask-based generative-AI architecture design interface developed by Leman Figen Gül and colleagues that converts user-created image collages into cohesive architectural renderings.
title: GAI-A (Generative Artificial Intelligence in Architecture) interface with Collage Tool

description: gAI is a deep-learning surgical video-overlay system developed by Hasegawa Takumi et al.
title: gAI (gastric cancer/gastrectomy artificial intelligence)

description: Song et al.'s GAIDE framework guides K–12 teachers through AI understanding, iterative collaborative design and prototyping, and reflection on ethical application when creating AI-powered learning technologies.
title: GAIDE: A Guiding Framework for AI-Integrated Design for Educators

description: A research-developed multimedia CD-ROM for biology learners that presents Darwin's Galapagos narrative and supports collaborative explanation construction with a Notepad, script window, and gated Model Answer.
title: Galapagos CD-ROM multimedia learning resource

description: Galaxy Math is an AIR-disseminated, space-themed one-to-one tutoring programme in which paraprofessionals provide at-risk first graders with frequent sessions focused on addition and subtraction.
title: Galaxy Math

description: Ventura et al.'s game-based assessment measures learner persistence from log-derived time spent on unsolved problems during gameplay.
title: Game-based assessment of persistence (GAP)

description: The Game Experience Questionnaire is a self-report instrument developed to measure multidimensional experiences of gameplay, including flow, immersion, competence, challenge, affect, and tension, and can be adapted for educational-game evaluation.
title: Game Experience Questionnaire (GEQ)

description: GAME is a generic automated marking environment developed by Blumenstein et al.
title: GAME: generic automated marking environment for programming assignments

description: The GPAI is a physical-education observational assessment instrument used to code students' in-game skill execution and tactical performance during live games or recordings.
title: Game Performance Assessment Instrument (GPAI)

description: Gapminder is a nonprofit-developed interactive data-visualization and exploration tool that helps learners compare country-level statistics over time.
title: Gapminder

description: A 25-item Likert-type questionnaire developed by Gardner for measuring learners' attitudes and motivation in language learning.
title: Gardner's Attitude/Motivation Test Battery (AMTB)

description: Gator Mentoring is a school-wide, full-year initiative that pairs at-risk middle-school students with adult staff mentors for bi-weekly support and guidance.
title: Gator Mentoring
